article.title: Can I change product quantities after booking?
article.lead: Yes. Quantity changes can be requested, but they remain subject to stock, delivery, labour and price confirmation.
article.quote: ✓ Your existing booking remains confirmed until an updated version is approved.

sections.title: Before requesting a change
sections.text: Have your booking reference ready and tell us which product, current quantity and requested quantity you want changed.

sections.title: What happens next?
sections.text: We send a revised quotation or booking change for your approval. Nothing changes until you accept it.

options: Use the reference from your confirmation email.
Choose the item and enter the required quantity.
We recheck availability, logistics and pricing.
article.note: Changes close to delivery may affect warehouse preparation, labour or transport charges.

sections.title: Prepare for delivery
items: Confirm venue access, loading and parking
Clear the setup area and protect pathways
Provide an on-site contact and phone number
Keep children, guests and pets clear of the crew
Confirm power, lifts, stairs and surface conditions

sections.title: Collect and return smoothly
items: Keep equipment dry, secure and grouped
Do not dismantle items unless instructed
Report damage or missing pieces promptly
Be ready for the confirmed collection window

safeUse.title: Use hired items correctly
safeUse.description: Follow product instructions and use equipment only for its intended event purpose.
items: Do not climb, stand on or modify furniture.
Secure outdoor items and follow wind restrictions.
Observe weight, age and occupancy limits.
Stop using unsafe items and contact us.
safeUse.quote: ⚠ Do not relocate marquees, heaters, staging or electrical equipment after professional setup.
